title: Discussion and Possible Action/Motion regarding a letter regarding a formal recommendation/complaint
text:
[NEW BUSINESS- DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE MOTIONS]
Discussion and Possible Action/Motion regarding a letter regarding a formal recommendation/complaint
to the Department of Recreation and Parks and the Board of Public Works regarding contract performance
and urban forestry impacts by Mariposa Landscaping. (Adele Slaughter) (5 Minutes)
Links to Photographs taken by Jack Smith at Northeast LA Forest School in the Children’s Garden at
Elysian Park, June 2024
summary: Discussion of a formal complaint regarding contract performance and urban forestry impacts by Mariposa Landscaping at the Northeast LA Forest School Children's Garden at Elysian Park.

flag.reason: Complaint about landscaping contractor's effect on trees in Elysian Park.
